Client Overview

Regional Healthcare Practice

Illinois-based medical practice serving patients across multiple specialties.

The Challenge

This established healthcare practice was facing increasing competition from larger hospital systems. Despite excellent patient outcomes, they were struggling with:

  • Declining new patient appointments (down 35% year-over-year)
  • Poor online visibility – ranking on page 3+ for key medical terms
  • Negative online reviews dominating search results
  • Previous agencies that didn’t understand HIPAA compliance
Our Solution

HIPAA-Compliant Strategy

Phase 1: Foundation & Compliance

  • HIPAA Compliance Audit: Reviewed all marketing materials for compliance
  • Website Redesign: Built modern, mobile-responsive, ADA-compliant website
  • Technical SEO: Fixed site speed issues, implemented SSL, optimized Core Web Vitals
  • Secure Analytics: Configured privacy-compliant tracking without capturing PHI

Phase 2: Content & Authority

  • Patient Education: Created 20+ blog posts answering common patient questions
  • Service Pages: Built comprehensive pages for each medical service
  • Provider Profiles: Highlighted doctor credentials and specialties
  • Local SEO: Optimized Google Business Profile and healthcare directories

Phase 3: Reputation & Acquisition

  • Review Generation: Implemented HIPAA-compliant review request process
  • Reputation Monitoring: Set up alerts for new reviews across platforms
  • Patient Testimonials: Collected compliant patient success stories
  • Targeted Ads: Ran Google Ads focusing on high-intent healthcare searches

Key Wins

  • Achieved page 1 rankings for “[specialty] near me” and condition-specific searches
  • Increased from 12 reviews (3.2★) to 127 reviews (4.8★)
  • Improved appointment request conversion from 2.1% to 8.7%
  • 165% increase in appointment calls from organic search

“Ava Digital understood our HIPAA compliance requirements from day one and built a strategy that grew our practice while protecting patient privacy. The 280% increase in new patients has allowed us to hire additional staff and expand our services.”

— Practice Administrator
